summary: Design and review identity-led access controls across cloud and hybrid services. Explore the five-day course and see how it fits your team.
lede: Zero Trust IAM training is for identity practitioners, cloud security specialists, and technical leads assessing access across cloud and hybrid environments. It covers authentication assurance, federation, role- and attribute-based authorization, and identity lifecycle controls. Exercises include mapping trust boundaries and access paths, reviewing privileged access, and producing access matrices and review checklists.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who configure, govern, investigate, or report on identity-based access across cloud and hybrid services. It suits people who can bring an existing access-control process or scenario to analyse.
prerequisites: Bring working knowledge of identity accounts, authentication, and access permissions in a cloud or hybrid environment. Coding is not required. Advanced topics such as risk-based authentication and workload identity are covered at conceptual and operational levels; the exercises focus on policy design and review artefacts rather than configuring a production identity platform.
